Internal calculation: Cohen's kappa sample size (Cantor 1996)

Source: R/calc-complex.R
calculate_kappa.Rd

Two modes:

  • task = "estimate": precision of a single kappa — n = Q * (z_(1-a/2) / d)^2, with the full Cantor Eq 3 asymptotic variance factor Q from the compatible joint rating table. Anchor: Cantor 1996 precision example (pi=0.3, kappa unspecified, Q=1.0, d=0.1, 80% CI -> 165).

  • task = "test": two independent kappas H0: K1 = K2 — n = (z_a sqrt(2 Q1) + z_b sqrt(Q1 + Q2))^2 / (K1 - K2)^2. Anchor: Cantor 1996 two-questionnaire example (pi=0.5, K1=0.7, K2=0.5, 95%/80% -> 214).

Usage

calculate_kappa(pi1, pi2, kappa1, kappa2, d, alpha, power, task)
